meaning: Construct a deterministic finite authored-composition behavior control family from checked source types, literals, declarations and binding phases, with independently interpreted expectations.
ownership: The project entry requires the registered unchanged graph and plan through independent composition binding, and the pinned graph-owned reference. The private fixture entry requires a compiler-validated declarative contract and inert source Calculation contracts; it is not an input validator or executable oracle interface.
wire: Fully tagged inert structural values preserve undefined versus omitted properties, bigint versus finite number, negative zero, field order, collection order and multiplicity. Plain and null-prototype records have identical structural meaning; prototype identity and alias identity are not claimed. Reject accessors, symbols, custom prototypes, cycles, sparse arrays, functions and non-finite numbers without calling user serializers. Closed canonical decoding produces fresh owned values.
seeds: Derive finite scalar boundary pools and authored literal neighbors; optional present, null, undefined and omission; empty, singleton, duplicate, distinct and reversed collection shapes. Recursion terminates through optional null or empty collection; required recursive records without a finite seed are unavailable. Preserve source field order. Materialize missing ancestors from the typed seed when varying nested slots.
coverage: Require a successful ordinary execution, successful input validation, successful declared guard and input phases, completed reachable declaration witnesses, and selection of every non-constant-false result case. Reachability conservatively traverses authored dependencies and binding phases, pruning only literal false result values, literal false Query projections and provably lazy literal arguments. Report statically inactive declarations and cases explicitly. A missing required witness makes the whole family unavailable, not an unsatisfiability proof. This is not exhaustive branch or domain coverage.
search: Use source reference outcomes and ordered observations only. Search deterministic lockstep scalar seeds followed by single-slot and bounded beam combinations. At most 4096 distinct input probes and three beam rounds with eight retained candidates. Search probes are not reported as completed control coverage. Required witnesses and the complete per-slot family around every distinct required-witness input and a successful ordinary input are retained, in every declared phase; no passing prefix is returned.
limits: Maximum 4095 final cases, 8 MiB encoded suite, 512 slots, 256 alternatives per slot. Wire capture bounds are depth 64, 20000 visits, 4096 array entries, 2048 record fields and 8 MiB text. Source-reference capacity exhaustion invalidates the whole family. Fixed limits are verifier construction boundaries, not new language restrictions.
evidence: Compare native outcomes and ordered observations after structural encoding, including expected domain failures. Exercise actual generated behavior and strict-compiled selected Calculation adapters; compiling behavioral mutants must execute and disagree. Reject malformed provenance or definitions separately from expected domain errors.
compatibility: Private foundation only. Preserve all 210 predecessor CLI sources, the 64-source capsule, public behavior availability and full R08-R18 scope. No endpoint, transport, operational provider, publication, installation, release or admission effects.
claim_ceiling: Finite source-derived local behavior witnesses, not universal semantic equivalence, runtime isolation, public verification integration or goal completion.
